sloka: तत: सरलतालाश्च तिलका नक्तमालका: ।प्रहृष्टास्तत्र सम्पेतु: कुब्जा भूत्वाथ वामना: ॥ २.९१.४९॥
transliteration: tata: saralatālāśca tilakā naktamālakā: ।prahṛṣṭāstatra sampetu: kubjā bhūtvātha vāmanā: ॥ 2.91.49॥

translations.english: At the command of Bharadwaja, bilva trees acted as drummers, vibhitaka trees as cymbalists and the pipal trees as dancers.
